original_ascii:
Workbench renderer
  |
  |-- EditorPart
  |   `-- SerializableGrid
  |       |-- SplitView / GridView
  |       |   `-- resize
  |       |       |-- redistribute space among neighboring panes
  |       |       `-- propagate dimensions ----------------------------+
  |       |                                                           |
  |       `-- EditorGroupView [one per group]                          |
  |           |-- layout(width, height, top, left) <--------------------+
  |           |   |-- lay out title / tabs
  |           |   `-- EditorPanes.layout
  |           |       `-- active EditorPane.layout
  |           |           `-- editor dimensions change
  |           |               |-- viewport changes
  |           |               `-- wrapping may change -----------+
  |           |                                                  |
  |           `-- EditorPanes                                    |
  |               `-- active text editor                         |
  |                   `-- CodeEditorWidget                       |
  |                       |                                      |
  |                       |-- ITextModel ------------------------|----------+
  |                       |                                      |          |
  |                       |-- ViewModel [per editor] <------------+          |
  |                       |   |-- view configuration                        |
  |                       |   |-- model-to-view line mapping                |
  |                       |   `-- viewport / selections                     |
  |                       |                                                 |
  |                       `-- View                                          |
  |                           |-- scrolling                                 |
  |                           |   `-- visible line range changes            |
  |                           |                                             |
  |                           |-- changed view parts / lines                |
  |                           |   `-- _scheduleRender                       |
  |                           |       `-- pending frame?                    |
  |                           |           |-- yes: reuse scheduled work     |
  |                           |           `-- no: enqueue ----------------+ |
  |                           |                                           | |
  |                           `-- rendering callbacks ------------------+ | |
  |                                                                     | | |
  |   TextModel [shared by editors displaying this document] <-----------|-|-+
  |   |                                                                 | |
  |   |-- typing / edits                                                | |
  |   |   `-- piece-tree text buffer                                    | |
  |   |       |-- original buffers + change buffer                      | |
  |   |       `-- update pieces instead of rebuilding the whole document | |
  |   |                                                                 | |
  |   `-- content changes                                               | |
  |       `-- attached ViewModels                                       | |
  |           `-- each editor updates its own view state                | |
  |               `-- affected Views schedule rendering                 | |
  |                                                                     | |
  `-- EditorRenderingCoordinator <--------------------------------------|-+
      |                                                                 |
      |-- queued editor renderings <------------------------------------+
      |-- animation-frame runners [by window]
      |
      `-- _onRenderScheduled
          |
          |-- 1. prepareRenderText [across queued editors]
          |   |-- disconnected DOM? ----------> skip editor
          |   |-- nothing dirty? -------------> skip editor
          |   `-- compute ViewportData
          |       `-- visible lines + whitespace + selections
          |
          |-- 2. renderText [across prepared editors]
          |   |-- ViewLines / ViewLinesGpu
          |   `-- collect view parts needing rendering
          |
          |-- 3. prepareRender [across prepared editors]
          |   `-- prepare changed view parts / measure geometry
          |
          `-- 4. render [across prepared editors]
              `-- update changed view parts
                  |
                  `-- browser rendering consequences [not code entities]
                      |-- style recalculation
                      |-- layout, when geometry is invalidated
                      `-- paint / compositing, as needed
